About Nabajyoti College
Nabajyoti College has been playing the pivotal role in disseminating knowledge and imparting higher education among the poor students of greater Kalgachia area since its inception (1971). The foundation stone was laid by Late Fakaruddin Ali Ahmed, the then Honourable President of India.
The authority of the College has always been patronizing to enhance the quality of education with an objective to build skill and capacity among the students for ensuring their employment in the fast changing scenario of the country.The College is also providing training to the students for building good health and morality through NSS, NCC, BS & G regularly. The NAAC of India has adjudged the quality of the College and accredited Grade B (Score: 2.73) in 2016.
Our Vision
To provide need-based, job-oriented and ethical education through technology, research, and collaborative learning, enhancing access to quality higher education for agro-based rural communities.
Our Mission
To develop outstanding scholars, responsible citizens, and quality educators through research, training, technology, critical analysis, and effective policies.

Principal's Desk
A word from the head of our institution.
Dr. Bijoy Barman
Principal, Nabajyoti College
It gives me immense pleasure to extend my warm greetings to all visitors of the official website of Nabajyoti College, Kalgachia.
Since its establishment, Nabajyoti College has been committed to providing quality higher education to the students of the region. Our institution strives to create an academic environment that nurtures knowledge, critical thinking, creativity, and ethical values. We believe that education is not only about acquiring information but also about developing character, responsibility, and a vision for a better society.

Infrastructure
Our Facilities
World-class infrastructure designed to support learning, research, and holistic development.
Library
A well-stocked central library housing over 65,000 volumes, digital resources, and dedicated reading halls for uninterrupted study.
Laboratories
Fully equipped science, computer, and language laboratories with modern instruments to support practical learning and research.
Smart Classrooms
Technology-integrated smart classrooms equipped with projectors, audio-visual systems, and interactive learning tools.
Sports Facilities
Expansive sports grounds, indoor courts, and gymnasium facilities catering to cricket, football, athletics, and more.
Auditorium
A 500-seat air-conditioned auditorium with modern acoustics for seminars, cultural programmes, and institutional events.
Wi-Fi Campus
High-speed broadband and seamless Wi-Fi connectivity across the entire campus enabling digital learning at every corner.
